overview_description.description:
*** Boundary has been acquired by BMC Corp in July 2015. Terms were not disclosed, but believed to be below VC money invested, less ~ $15-17M still hold by Boundary at that time. Most engineers were hired by BMC.  "Boundary Premium" was rebranded to "TruSight Pulse" and is offered at: http://www.bmc.com/truesightpulse. Boundary Enterprise is no longer available to new customers. ***

Boundary is Application Aware Infrastructure Performance Monitoring. Requires zero change to the application, is agnostic across languages and infrastructures, sits on every VM, collects massive amounts of performance data, consolidates data from other sources and puts it all in context with its unique, real-time application map.

Boundary offers all of these features:

- SaaS- No scoping, procuring, deploying or managing hardware, no complicated software upgrades, and no delay in getting up and running.

- Open Architecture- Leverage our extensive library of adapters or use our REST API to build custom adapters quickly- or we can do it for you.

- Real-time Views- Unique, per-second application chatter and operations analytics provide an immediate view and an always current application topology.

- Immediate Alerting- Find out about changes and code updates as they happen, and instantly track the impact.

-Intuitive User Interface- Support more than 20 server OS using one small and easy to use agent. 

- Historical Data- Rewind time, see granular activity and analyze event data from an entire year. Spot trends and find problems faster.

-Wide Coverage of Popular Technologies- Web Servers, SQL and NoSQL Databases, Load Balancers, Message Queues, Caches, etc. 

-Alerts- Send notifications to your favorite communication tool
